target_info.name: Estrella de Barnard
target_info.description: La estrella solitaria más cercana a la Tierra (5.96 al). Su descomunal velocidad angular de 10.3 segundos de arco por año cruza el campo SPHEREx visiblemente.

blink.provenance: NASA IRSA SPHEREx Data Standard Service
blink.tap_query_executed: SELECT 'https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/' || a.uri || '?center=269.4521,4.6934d&size=0.0833' AS uri, p.time_bounds_lower, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 269.4521, 4.6934), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
